urgent.heading: Ingxamisekile — tsalela umnxeba ngoku
urgent.primary_message: Biza i-ambulensi ngoko nangoko. Qaphela ixesha kanye apho iimpawu ziqale khona.
red_flags: Icala elinye lobuso liyawa — mcele ancume
Ubuthathaka bengalo kwicala elinye — mcele aphakamise iingalo zombini
Intetho iyaxakaniseka okanye ayiqhelekanga — mcele aphinde isivakalisi
Intloko ebuhlungu kakhulu ngesiquphe ngaphandle kwesizathu esaziwayo
Ukuphulukana nokubona ngesiquphe kwiliso elinye okanye omabini

what_is_it.heading: Istroke ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Istroke yenzeka xa ukuhamba kwegazi kwinxalenye yobuchopho kumiswa ngesiquphe. Iiseli zobuchopho ziqala ukufa ngemizuzu.
paragraphs: Uninzi lwee-stroke lwenzeka xa ihlwili legazi livala umthambo wegazi ebuchotsheni. Ezinye zenzeka xa umthambo uqhuma igazi livuze. Zombini ziimeko ezingxamisekileyo kwaye zisenokubonakala zifana ngaphandle — akunakwenzeka ukwazi ukuba yeyiphi ngaphandle kovavanyo esibhedlele.

Okukhona istroke sinyangwa ngokukhawuleza, kokukhona inxalenye enkulu yobuchopho ingasindiswa. Amayeza aqhekeza amahlwili asebenza kakhulu kwiiyure zokuqala ezimbalwa. Emva koko umonakalo uba sisigxina. Yiyo loo nto imizuzu ibalulekile.

items.headline: Imizuzu ibalulekile
items.body: Malunga nezigidi ezi-2 zeeseli zobuchopho ziyafa ngomzuzu ngamnye ngexesha le-stroke. Ixesha liqala kuphawu lokuqala.
Abantu baseMzantsi Afrika abangaphezu kwama-80 000 bafumana istroke minyaka le. Sisizathu esikhulu sokukhubazeka nokusweleka kwabantu abadala.

items.headline: Sinokuthintelwa
items.body: Uninzi lwee-stroke lunxulumene noxinzelelo lwegazi oluphezulu, ukutshaya, isifo seswekile nokutya — zonke ezi zinto zinokulawulwa.

items.headline: Ukuchacha kunokwenzeka
items.body: Ukwenza into kwiyure yokuqala kunika elona thuba lihle lokuchacha ngokupheleleyo. Izibhedlele zinezonyango ezixhomekeke kakhulu kwixesha.

pull_quote.text: Ukuba ukrokrela istroke, musa ukulinda ubone ukuba kuza kuhamba njani. Biza i-ambulensi. Nokuba iimpawu ziyadlula ngokwazo — naloo nto luphawu lwesilumkiso.

signs.heading: Uvavanyo lwe-FAST
signs.lede: Iimpawu zestroke ziqala ngesiquphe. Okukhona uzibona ngokukhawuleza, kokukhona inxalenye enkulu yobuchopho ingasindiswa. Khumbula u-FAST.

items.title: F — Ubuso buyawa
items.description: Mcele ancume. Ngaba icala elinye lomlomo okanye lobuso liyawa, nokuba kancinci?

items.title: A — Ubuthathaka bengalo
items.description: Mcele aphakamise iingalo zombini. Ngaba enye iyehla okanye ivakala ingathi ayinamdla? Ngaba angazibamba zombini phezulu ngokulinganayo?

items.title: S — Ingxaki yokuthetha
items.description: Mcele aphinde isivakalisi esilula. Ngaba intetho yakhe iyaxakaniseka, ayiqhelekanga okanye kunzima ukuyiqonda?

items.title: T — Ixesha lokutsalela umnxeba
items.description: Ukuba ubona naluphi na olu phawu, Tsalela umnxeba ku-10177 ngoko nangoko. Qaphela ixesha kanye apho iimpawu ziqale khona.

items.fact: Istroke sinokwenzeka nakweyiphi na iminyaka. Malunga ne-1 kwezine zee-stroke zenzeka kubantu abangaphantsi kweminyaka engama-65, kwaye liyanda inani labantu abatsha abalichaphazelekayo.

items.myth: Ukuba iimpawu zidlula ngokukhawuleza, ibingeyiyo istroke yokwenene.
items.fact: Isiqendu esifutshane (TIA okanye 'mini-stroke') sisilumkiso esikhulu. Malunga ne-1 kwabathathu abane-TIA baya kuba nestroke esipheleleyo — abaninzi kwiiyure ezingama-48.

items.myth: Kungcono ndimqhubele esibhedlele ngokwam — kukhawuleza kunokulinda i-ambulensi.
items.fact: Abeparamedic baqala unyango kwi-ambulensi baze bamse kwisibhedlele esikwaziyo ukunyanga istroke. Ukuziqhubela okanye ukumqhuba kunokuchitha ixesha elibalulekileyo kwaye kuyingozi.
Musa ukunika i-aspirin xa ukrokrela istroke. Ukuba sisifo sokopha ebuchotsheni, i-aspirin ingayenza mandundu. Biza i-ambulensi ulinde.

items.title: Tsalela umnxeba ku-10177 okanye ku-112 ngoko nangoko
items.description: Yitsho ngokucacileyo igama elithi 'stroke'. Abeparamedic baya kubeka imeko phambili baze bakuse kwisibhedlele esikwaziyo ukunyanga istroke.

items.title: Qaphela ixesha kanye apho iimpawu ziqale khona
items.description: Oku kugqiba ukuba zeziphi iindlela zonyango ezinokwenzeka. Nokuba lixesha eliqikelelweyo liyanceda iqela lasesibhedlele.

items.title: Musa ukunika ukutya, amanzi okanye iyeza
items.description: Umntu usenokuba nengxaki yokuginya. Musa ukumnika nantoni na ngomlomo — kuquka ne-aspirin.

items.title: Ukuba akaphaphamanga, mlalise ngecala
items.description: Indawo yokuchacha igcina indlela yomoya ivulekile. Ukuba uyaphaphama, mgcine ekhululekile kwaye umqinisekise.

items.title: Hlala naye de kufike abeparamedic
items.description: Jonga ukuphefumla kwakhe. Lungela ukwenza i-CPR ukuba uyeka ukuphefumla. Vula ucango ukuze abeparamedic bakwazi ukungena.

get_help.heading: Ngubani omawumfowunele ngoku
get_help.lede: Istroke esikrokrelwayo yimeko engxamisekileyo. tsalela umnxeba ngoku. Musa ukuziqhubela okanye ukulinda ukuba iimpawu zidlule ngokwazo.
